sources.entry: Peninsula - Dynamic Peninsula for macOS, focusing on window switching, notifications, and file storage. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Celve/Peninsula) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Peninsula is a macOS notch app that replaces Cmd-Tab with a window switcher and adds notification, file tray, and timer features inside the notch area.
summary.what_it_does: Replaces the default Cmd-Tab with a window switcher that cycles through apps with cmd+tab and shift for reverse. A separate keyboard shortcut opens a search-based switcher where typing a window name filters the list and enter switches to it. Clicking the notch cycles through five Peninsula windows: an inner-screen app switcher, a notification center, a tray for temporary files, a menu for basic actions such as quitting, and settings. The notification center lets you pick favorite apps whose icons appear beside the notch when notifications arrive, then show a notification count. A timer can be set by scrolling wheels or typing patterns like "2h15m".
use_cases: switch between open windows on macOS
search for a window by name and jump to it
see notification counts from chosen apps in the notch
keep temporary files in a notch tray
set a countdown timer from the menu bar area
how_to_run: Go to Releases and download the latest version (zip).
Unzip the file and run Peninsula.app.
Trust the app in Privacy & Security in System Settings.
Grant access to Accessibility (needed for app list and notification count).
Alternatively, build the app yourself from the GitHub repo.
stack: Swift (implied for macOS app; not named in README)
notable: Replaces macOS Cmd-Tab with a window switcher adapted from alt-tab-macos
Search-driven window switcher triggered by a custom shortcut
Five notch windows cycled by clicking the original notch
Notification center shows app icons in the notch, then a count after about 6 seconds
Timer accepts typed durations such as 2h15m
caveats: Requires Accessibility permission for app list and notification counts
Must be trusted in Privacy & Security settings before running
Only applies to Macs with a notch, as implied by the description
